findings.situation: The filer's employer hired a care provider (for example, contracted a nanny agency or a daycare) under its dependent care plan and paid that provider directly for the filer's child.
findings.source_text: i2441 p. 3, Columns (a) and (b): "your employer furnished the care (either at your workplace or by hiring a care provider) ... enter -0- in column (e). But if your employer paid a third party (not hired by your employer) on your behalf to provide the care, you must provide information on the third party"
findings.why: The question includes "amounts your employer paid to the provider on your behalf" and gives zero only "if your employer furnished the care." It never says that care from a provider your employer hired counts as furnished by the employer. A filer in this situation could reasonably report the employer's payments, when the lines need -0-.
